description: This Python script generates and tests certificate chains with various name constraints and subject alternative names for unit testing purposes.

methods.name: add_excluded_name_constraints
methods.description: Adds excluded name constraints to a certificate with specified counts for DNS, IP, directory names, and URIs.

methods.name: add_permitted_name_constraints
methods.description: Adds permitted name constraints to a certificate with specified counts for DNS, IP, directory names, and URIs.

methods.name: add_sans
methods.description: Adds subject alternative names to a certificate with specified counts for DNS, IP, directory names, and URIs.

methods.name: make_chain
methods.description: Creates a certificate chain with specified constraints and names, then writes it to a file.
